changes: Research gold evaluation now runs only after AgentRuntime termination and binds hidden theory, algorithm, and empirical checks to exact runtime-visible question and accepted-artifact hashes; it cannot revise model artifacts or feed expected values back into the run.

Real hidden evaluator artifacts live under operator-controlled local authority outside the repository and RAG-visible tree. The repository contains only explicitly non-authoritative mock fixtures for deterministic tests and public evaluator hashes.

The L0 ladder has one fully gold-configured HC0 task and zero passing full tasks. Required theory, empirical runtime acceptance, unresolved-gap reporting, and overall completion remain failed after v5.

The visible HC0 benchmark now distinguishes finite-sample covariance of beta_hat from the normalized asymptotic covariance of sqrt(n)(beta_hat-beta), and requires appropriate asymptotic regularity rather than finite-sample rank alone.
Research summaries recover immutable stage-local accepted theory and scientific-code evidence even when no final Critic is reached, without promoting those dimensions to overall task completion.

Hidden empirical validation is now reported separately from runtime protocol acceptance. Passing hidden behavior cannot erase a failed frozen runtime gate, and a runtime block cannot erase independently observed hidden behavior.

A failed confirmatory outcome no longer returns to Simulation source for result-informed rewriting or an automatic second execution. After independent source review it continues only to the task-intent downstream evidence lane and terminal gap reporting.

When all substantive lanes are terminal, an Architect BLOCK packet cannot suppress required Critic gap reporting; the existing typed packet validator requires the terminal reporter without adding a retry budget.

Metric semantic controls use one comparison-scale value per frozen row. The production evaluator checks that exact value through the frozen operator and gate instead of interpreting an ambiguous list of raw values.

Metric author and reviewer prompts require finite-run uncertainty justification and joint portfolio attainability. Aggregate confirmatory failure cannot be attributed to a component without component-specific executable evidence.
Independent theory preflight now audits sample-size scaling and re-applies theorem normalization, while leaving the mathematical derivation and source correction to TheoryDeveloper.
Malformed simulation-consumer requests remain owned by Simulation source; exceptions raised by an accepted estimator remain owned by Algorithm source.
Product research may mark formalization not applicable or advisory without blocking non-formal evidence. Strict S13 continues to require exact target-bound kernel closure.
validated_change.anti_hardcoding_audit: No HC0, survival, sequential, FDR, conformal, task-family condition, statistical answer, metric threshold, Lean grammar/tactic rule, repair worker, or fallback scheduler was added to executable production code. The post-v5 mechanism uses only task intent, confirmatory outcome identity, source-execution status, remaining-lane state, and evidence authority.
